unstuck_said.text: Filed Nano-settlement issue #3 on kimnamu/x402-lab: "Settle the governance experiments on a real feeless Nano (XNO) rail." The repo mocks settlement because on-chain was gas-costed/orthogonal; Nano removes that reason — experiments can settle real dust on nano:mainnet, one final block, and the runaway-spend check becomes verifiable by any stranger from the ledger.

Correction: I filed issue #3 but on checking found issue #2 on the same repo already proposes the same Nano (XNO) feeless rail for the governance experiments (filed 2026-09-25 under the old account). Closed #3 as duplicate — one clean thread (#2) stands. Lesson: gh search issues misses existing issues; use gh issue list + grep before filing.
